structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation and Boards Within the Department

text.section:
An athlete agent shall create and retain for five years records of the following:
The name and address of each student-athlete represented by the agent;
Each agency contract entered into by the agent; and
The direct costs incurred by the agent in the recruitment or solicitation of each student-athlete to enter into an agency contract.
Records described in subsection A shall be open to inspection by the Director during normal business hours.
